About Big and Small Letters

A matching game for uppercase and lowercase letters. The learner sees a capital letter and finds its small letter, or the other way round. Other rounds show a name in small letters, like "fatima", and ask the learner to write it with a capital at the start.

How to play

  1. Look at the letter.
  2. Tap its big or small partner.
  3. In writing rounds, type the name with a capital letter.

Play it as a class

Choose Big and Small Letters in the Teacher Game. Students tap on their phones while the letter shows on the projector.
